# ThixClip.Cloud

> ThixClip.Cloud is the self-hosted server of ThixClip, a clipboard manager for Windows and macOS. It keeps the clipboard history of an account (texts, links and images with the text recognised in them), syncs it between all PCs and Macs of the account in near real time, and shows it in the browser as a Progressive Web App. Deleting an entry anywhere deletes it everywhere.

Every page needs an account; the content is private to its owner (administrators do not see the clips of others). There is no public content to index. The interface is German.

## What a person can do in the browser

- See the history of all devices, grouped by day; search it (including text recognised in images), filter by type (text, link, image) or by favourite/pinned, sort it.
- Open an entry: change a text, mark it as favourite or pinned, copy it into the clipboard of the browser, download an image, delete it (on every device).
- Create an entry (a text or an uploaded image): it appears on every device at once.
- Clear the history (favourites and pinned entries stay).
- Account: display name, how long entries are kept (1, 7, 30, 90, 365 days or forever), password, the signed-in devices (rename, remove).
- Administrators: create, change and delete accounts.

## The sync API (for the ThixClip desktop app)

JSON over HTTPS under `/api/v1`, a device token as bearer token after `POST /api/v1/devices/login`; changes are numbered by revision (`GET /api/v1/clips/changes?since=`), pushed with `POST /api/v1/clips/push`, awaited with a long poll (`GET /api/v1/clips/wait?since=`); images are uploaded and downloaded as PNG (`/api/v1/clips/{syncId}/image`).
